# Minnesota Department of Public Safety

> State agency providing law enforcement, emergency management, driver services, and public safety programs across Minnesota.

The Minnesota Department of Public Safety (DPS) is the primary state agency responsible for maintaining public safety, managing emergency services, and regulating driver and vehicle services. DPS operates multiple specialized divisions including the Minnesota State Patrol, Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, and Homeland Security and Emergency Management.

## Key Topics

- Driver and Vehicle Services
- Minnesota State Patrol
- Bureau of Criminal Apprehension
- Law Enforcement
- Public Safety
- Emergency Management
- Driver License
- Vehicle Registration
- Alcohol and Gambling Enforcement
- State Fire Marshal
- Homeland Security
- Missing and Murdered Black Women and Girls
- Office of Justice Programs
- Emergency Communication Networks
- Office of Pipeline Safety
